contract.successful_unregister: unregister() returns True when the matching listener exists and is removed
contract.absent_listener_unregister: unregister() returns False when the matching listener is already absent
contract.removal_effect: A successfully unregistered listener is removed from the registry and is not delivered subsequent events
contract.remaining_listener_delivery: Remaining listeners continue receiving events in registration order
contract.registry_stability: Repeated unregister attempts do not corrupt the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Unregister continues to require the events permission
